name: 原色纸皮薄壳干核桃款
description: 壳薄易开、果仁完整的原色干核桃套图，散称与独立包装皆宜

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep pine-green #1E5A50 poster panels, warm cream #F6EDD8 info panels, pure white #FFFFFF packshots
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the front-left, gentle contact shadows, golden skimming light for shell texture
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light natural wood plank #B08A63 and matte cream board #F6EDD8
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with gold accent headings
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line gold icons with blank round badge frames
styleLock.presentationRules: walnuts shown whole in-shell in a shallow woven bamboo basket with one cracked open to reveal the kernel; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent natural orchard dried-fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine-green #1E5A50, warm cream #F6EDD8, amber-gold #C9A25E and walnut brown #8A6849; warm soft studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with gold accent headings; thin-line gold icon style with blank round badge frames; clean appetizing food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product presentation with walnuts shown whole in-shell and cracked to reveal the kernel; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首屏干净合规，一眼看清整篮干核桃的自然形态
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level view, shallow woven bamboo basket centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: none, only a clean margin around the basket
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A shallow woven bamboo basket heaped with whole in-shell walnuts, one cracked open to reveal the kernel, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level view with the basket centered. Bright even high-key studio light with a front key and soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the basket. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond a clean margin around the basket. 8K commercial food ecommerce quality. Negative: no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no mould, no unrealistic portion size, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 深绿海报+藤篮整核桃与开壳核桃、金色标题、红色绶带与底部三枚绿标；P2 产品小档案参数卡（品名纸皮核桃，另含规格、保质期等数值行）与米黄产地文案区；P3 果园枝头青果照片、定位图标与三张产地卡片（含纬度数值）；P4 深绿卖点屏三段文案（含果径数值与出仁率表述）；P5 米黄双横卡（白底藤篮图+绿竖标）；P6 两张空占位卡（原色、独立包装）；P7 深绿营养屏、核桃仁配金色圆点轨道（维生素等字样）；P8 米黄四宫格场景卡（办公室/全家/长辈/朋友分享）+ 二维码会员角标。品类判定：参数区品名为纸皮核桃，袋装散称初级干货、自然脱落手工挑选、未调味未炒制、常温阴凉储存，属散装初级农产品而非预包装炒货，按历史改判惯例（菌菇/大米同类）判为生鲜粮油/粮油，leaf 记为原色纸皮薄壳干核桃，与库内休闲零食类薄皮核桃件区分。已剥离：素材站水印、会员角标与二维码、品牌与店铺字样、省域县域产地宣称与纬度数值、规格/保质期/果径等全部数值、出仁率与营养功效表述（含润泽肌肤等断言）、绶带与绿标原文案；数值与资质一律改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白占位。
